title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - TrackingRecord
description: Tracking records allow the tracking of modifications on the problem. The tracking records should not be embedded in the problem to allow retrieving the problem without the tracking records (TM Forum TMF628 Performance 4.0.0, Swagger definition TrackingRecord; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:TrackingRecord:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TrackingRecord'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:TrackingRecord:<tmfId>. Identifier of the TrackingRecord

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/description'. Describes the action being done, such as: ack, clear

systemId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/systemId'. Describes the system Id from which the action was done

time.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/time'. Describes the time at which the action was done

user.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/user'. Describes the user doing the action

Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/characteristic'. A generic list of any type of elements. Used for vendor Extensions or loose element encapsulation from other namespaces

Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TrackingRecord/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships
